name: hungering_arrow_seek_after_pierce_yards
notes: Hungering Arrow: how far from the enemy it pierced the arrow looks for the next one to strike. The sheet says only 'seeks out enemies' and gives no distance; Power/DemonHunter_HungeringArrow.pow SF_13 'Search Radius After Pierce' = 20

name: hungering_arrow_shatter_seek_yards
notes: Hungering Arrow - Shatter Shot: how far from the pierced enemy the split arrows look for enemies to strike. Power/DemonHunter_HungeringArrow.pow SF_4 'B: Search Radius' = 11

name: hungering_arrow_shatter_cone_degrees
notes: Hungering Arrow - Shatter Shot: the width of the cone behind the pierced enemy that the split arrows fly into, centred on the way the arrow was flying. Power/DemonHunter_HungeringArrow.pow SF_19 'B: Cone Size Behind Target' = 50 (the file gives no unit; read as degrees). 360 sends an arrow to any enemy around

name: hungering_arrow_travel_yards
notes: Hungering Arrow: how far from where it was shot the arrow can still pierce on to another enemy (the first enemy is the skill's range, skill_targeting.csv). Power/DemonHunter_HungeringArrow.pow SF_14 'Projectile Max Dist from Cast Location' = 90

name: entangling_shot_search_yards
notes: Entangling Shot: how far from the enemy hit the shot looks for the other enemies it entangles (nearest first, up to the sheet's count). The sheet says only 'entangles up to N enemies' and gives no distance; Power/X1_DemonHunter_EntanglingShot.pow SF_17 'Jump Search Radius' = 80

name: entangling_shot_shock_collar_tick_seconds
notes: Entangling Shot - Shock Collar: the interval between the ticks of the Lightning the entangled enemies take over the rune's 2 seconds (80% in all). The sheet gives the total and the seconds, and the power file no tick length (SF_8 'Electrical Damage Scalar' = 0.40 reads as a share for each second); the designer's standing default for a damage over time, 0.5 seconds (2026-10-22)

name: bolas_impact_damage_pct
notes: Bolas: the weapon damage of the bola itself when it lands, before the explosion that carries the damage. Power/DemonHunter_Bolas.pow SF_10 'Base: Weapon Damage' = 0.0001 (a fraction of weapon damage, so 0.01 percent)

name: bolas_travel_yards
notes: Bolas - Freezing Strike: how far from the Demon Hunter the extra bolas look for enemies to hit. Power/DemonHunter_Bolas.pow SF_3 'Projectile Max Travel Distance' = 75 (also the skill's cast range, skill_targeting.csv)

name: bolas_freezing_strike_cone_degrees
notes: Bolas - Freezing Strike: the width of the cone ahead of the Demon Hunter, centred on the enemy aimed at, that the extra bolas fly into. Power/DemonHunter_Bolas.pow SF_12 'B: Target Area Angle' = 90 (the file gives no unit; read as degrees)

name: bolas_freezing_strike_shot_delay_seconds
notes: Bolas - Freezing Strike: how long after the one before each further bola of the volley is shot and so explodes. Power/DemonHunter_Bolas.pow SF_13 'B: Delay Per Shot' = 0.1

name: evasive_fire_flip_search_yards
notes: Evasive Fire: how near an enemy in front of the Demon Hunter must be for the backflip (and Hardened's armor instead of it) to happen. The sheet says only 'an enemy in front of you at close range'; Power/X1_DemonHunter_EvasiveFire.pow SF_5 'Melee Safety Radius' = 25

name: evasive_fire_flip_search_degrees
notes: Evasive Fire: the width of the cone in front of the Demon Hunter in which an enemy sets off the backflip. Power/X1_DemonHunter_EvasiveFire.pow SF_6 'Melee Search Angle' = 60 (the file gives no unit; read as degrees)

name: evasive_fire_enemies_hit
notes: Evasive Fire: how many enemies the bolts hit in all, the enemy aimed at and the nearest ones beside it (the sheet says the primary enemy and two additional ones). Power/X1_DemonHunter_EvasiveFire.pow SF_24 'B: Max Monsters Hit' = 3

name: evasive_fire_spread_degrees
notes: Evasive Fire: the width of the cone, centred on the enemy aimed at, that the enemies beside it must stand in to be hit. Power/X1_DemonHunter_EvasiveFire.pow SF_26 'B: Angle' = 50 (the file gives no unit; read as degrees, and read for every rune)

name: grenade_cluster_pulses
notes: Grenade - Cluster Grenades: how many pulses share the rune's 200% weapon damage. The sheet says 'over a 9 yard radius'; Power/DemonHunter_Grenades.pow SF_28 'B: Extra Pulse' = 2 more than the first, and SF_17 divides the damage by that count plus one (1.6 x 1.25 / 3 = 0.667 a pulse, 200% in all)

name: grenade_cluster_pulse_seconds
notes: Grenade - Cluster Grenades: the time between one pulse and the next. Power/DemonHunter_Grenades.pow SF_12 'B: Pulse Duration' = 0.6 (the file does not say whether it is the gap between pulses or the length of them all; read as the gap)

name: grenade_cloud_tick_seconds

name: grenade_cloud_radius_yards
notes: Grenade - Cold Grenade: the radius of the cloud the grenade leaves. Power/DemonHunter_Grenades.pow SF_5 'A: Cloud Radius' = 6

name: grenade_cloud_chill_pct
notes: Grenade - Cold Grenade: how much the cloud slows the enemies standing in it (Chill). Power/DemonHunter_Grenades.pow SF_34 'A: Chill Amount' = 0.60

name: grenade_cache_spread_degrees
notes: Grenade - Grenade Cache: the angle between one grenade of the fan and the next. name: impale_pierce_width_yards
notes: Impale - Overpenetration: how wide the line the knife pierces along is. Neither the sheet nor Power/DemonHunter_Impale.pow gives a width; the designer's standing default for a line attack, 3 yards (2026-10-22)

name: impale_impact_knockback_yards

name: impale_chemical_burn_tick_seconds
notes: Impale - Chemical Burn: the interval between the ticks of the burn. The sheet gives the total (500% over 2 seconds) and the power file no tick length; the designer's standing default for a burn, 0.5 seconds (2026-10-22)

name: impale_ricochet_damage_factor

name: rapid_fire_shots_per_attack

name: rapid_fire_bombardment_shots_per_attack
notes: Rapid Fire - Bombardment: the same for the grenades, which come at half the rate. Power/DemonHunter_RapidFire.pow SF_21 'A: Crimson Speed Multiplier' = 3

name: rapid_fire_rocket_warmup_seconds

name: rapid_fire_rocket_range_yards

name: rapid_fire_grenade_range_yards
notes: Rapid Fire - Bombardment: how far a grenade flies. Power/DemonHunter_RapidFire.pow SF_15 'A: Max Grenade Range' = 50

name: rapid_fire_pierce_length_yards
notes: Rapid Fire - High Velocity: how far an arrow flies along the line it pierces on. The skill's range, 60 yards (skill_targeting.csv; Power/DemonHunter_RapidFire.pow AttackRadius)

name: rapid_fire_pierce_width_yards
notes: Rapid Fire - High Velocity: how wide the line an arrow pierces along is. Neither the sheet nor the power file gives a width; the designer's standing default for a line attack, 3 yards (2026-10-22)

name: chakram_cloud_tick_seconds
notes: Chakram - Shuriken Cloud: the interval between the cloud's ticks; each carries that share of the rune's 200% a second. Power/DemonHunter_Chakram.pow SF_9 'E: Buff Tick Rate' = 0.5

name: chakram_cloud_radius_yards
notes: Chakram - Shuriken Cloud: how far from the Demon Hunter the cloud reaches. Power/DemonHunter_Chakram.pow SF_15 'E: Area' = 8

name: chakram_cloud_cooldown_seconds
notes: Chakram - Shuriken Cloud: the rune's cooldown (the skill and its other runes have none). Power/DemonHunter_Chakram.pow SF_8 'E: Cooldown' = 10, CooldownTime = Rune_E ? SF_8 : 0

name: elemental_arrow_cone_radius_yards

name: elemental_arrow_cone_degrees
notes: Elemental Arrow - Frost Arrow: the width of the cone, behind the enemy struck, that the split arrows fly into. Power/DemonHunter_ElementalArrow.pow SF_14 'RuneA: Conal Freeze Angle' = 120

name: elemental_arrow_cone_delay_seconds
notes: Elemental Arrow - Frost Arrow: the pause between the first arrow's hit and the split arrows'. Power/DemonHunter_ElementalArrow.pow SF_16 'RuneA: Conal Hit Delay Time' = 0.17

name: elemental_arrow_ball_seek_yards
notes: Elemental Arrow - Ball Lightning: how far from the ball an enemy is shocked. Power/DemonHunter_ElementalArrow.pow SF_22 'RuneB: Seek Radius' = 15

name: elemental_arrow_ball_tick_seconds

name: elemental_arrow_ball_shock_delay_seconds
notes: Elemental Arrow - Ball Lightning: the pause between the two shocks of one tick; each is half the rune's damage (SF_26 'RuneB: Lightning Damage Scalar' = 1.5 against the sheet's 300%). Power/DemonHunter_ElementalArrow.pow SF_24 'RuneB: Delay between shocks' = 0.1

name: elemental_arrow_tentacle_tick_seconds
notes: Elemental Arrow - Nether Tentacles: the interval between the tentacle's strikes. Power/DemonHunter_ElementalArrow.pow SF_30 'RuneD: Tick Interval' = 0.35

name: elemental_arrow_tentacle_radius_yards
notes: Elemental Arrow - Nether Tentacles: how far from the tentacle an enemy is struck. Power/DemonHunter_ElementalArrow.pow SF_31 'RuneD: Tentacles Radius' = 6

name: elemental_arrow_immolation_tick_seconds
notes: Elemental Arrow - Immolation Arrow: the interval between the burning ground's ticks; each carries that share of the rune's 315%. Power/DemonHunter_ElementalArrow.pow SF_2 'RuneC: AoE DoT Tickrate' = 0.5

name: elemental_arrow_slow_projectile_yards_per_second
notes: Elemental Arrow - Ball Lightning and Nether Tentacles: how fast the ball and the tentacle fly. name: elemental_arrow_travel_yards
notes: Elemental Arrow - Ball Lightning and Nether Tentacles: how far the ball and the tentacle fly before they end. The power file gives no distance; the skill's range, 60 yards (skill_targeting.csv, q-1021-46 (a)). A placeholder for the PM to card

name: caltrops_tick_seconds
notes: Caltrops: the interval between the sprung trap's ticks, each of which slows (and, for Jagged Spikes, hurts) the enemies in the area. Power/DemonHunter_Caltrops.pow SF_1 'Tick-Rate Interval' = 0.25

name: caltrops_slow_seconds
notes: Caltrops: how long each tick's slow lasts, so that it holds while the enemy stays in the area and lapses soon after it leaves. Power/DemonHunter_Caltrops.pow SF_4 'slow duration' = 0.5

name: caltrops_activation_wait_seconds
notes: Caltrops: how long a trap waits for an enemy before it goes away unsprung. Power/DemonHunter_Caltrops.pow SF_9 'Activation Wait Time' = 30

name: caltrops_max_traps
notes: Caltrops: how many traps stand at once; the oldest give way. Power/DemonHunter_Caltrops.pow SF_10 'Max Traps' = 5

name: caltrops_bait_linger_seconds
notes: Caltrops - Bait the Trap: how long the critical hit chance lasts after each tick (every caltrops_tick_seconds, 0.25 = SF_1 and the designer's standing default for a trigger check) finds the Demon Hunter in the area. A placeholder for the PM to card: two ticks, so one missed check does not drop it

name: smoke_screen_movement_speed_pct

name: smoke_screen_regen_tick_seconds
notes: Smoke Screen - Healing Vapors: the interval between the Life shares it gives while invisible (15% of the maximum Life for each second, split over the shares). name: shadow_power_life_on_hit_healing_share

name: vault_action_shot_interval_seconds

name: vault_action_shot_range_yards
notes: Vault - Action Shot: how far from the Demon Hunter an arrow looks for an enemy ('nearby enemies'). name: vault_trail_tick_seconds
notes: Vault - Trail of Cinders: the interval between the fire's ticks on the enemies standing in it; each carries that share of the rune's 300% over 3 seconds. Power/DemonHunter_Vault.pow SF_12 'A: Fire Trail Tick Rate' = 0.2

name: vault_trail_width_yards
notes: Vault - Trail of Cinders: how wide the trail of fire is, along the path the vault takes. Neither the sheet nor the power file gives a width; the designer's standing default for a line attack, 3 yards (2026-10-22)

name: vault_stun_area_yards

name: vault_stun_strip_width_yards

name: vault_stun_check_seconds

name: vault_knockback_yards

name: vengeance_split_shot_cooldown_attacks

name: vengeance_split_shot_spread_min_degrees

name: vengeance_split_shot_spread_degrees

name: vengeance_split_shot_offset_yards

name: vengeance_mortar_min_range_yards

name: vengeance_mortar_max_range_yards

name: vengeance_shadow_ally_range_yards

name: vengeance_shadow_ally_freeze_cooldown_seconds
